messages:
Priya: Hey team — hosting a client in Philly next Wed near our South St office. Need quick lunch recs (<=30min) and an early coffee spot for an 8am meet. One attendee is vegan, another needs GF. Any go-to places?
Tom: Vedge is the easy vegan win, but it's sit-down and a bit slower — amazing food tho. If you want <30m, check High Street Philly (lots of veg-friendly options).
Lena: For 8am coffee: La Colombe (Seaport-ish vibe) or ReAnimator on Passyunk for pour-overs. Both open early.
Jorge: Zahav is excellent for scoring a group dinner but not lunch quick. Reading Terminal Market is perfect for mixed diets — you can each grab something (GF, vegan stalls).
Maya: Federal Donuts is great if you need super fast and casual, but not much for GF. For a filling GF-friendly sandwich, try DiNic's (get the roast pork, they do GF options on request).
Katherine: If the client wants something Philly-classic and you're okay with casual: try John's Roast Pork or Steve's Prince of Steaks — note: cheesesteak options are mostly not GF but they can do lettuce-wraps sometimes.
Priya: Good notes — trying to keep it polished but quick. Would you recommend pre-ordering anywhere?
Tom: High Street lets you call ahead. Reading Terminal you can't pre-order across vendors but it's fast once inside. Zahav strongly recommend reserve if you go sit-down.
Lena: For very quick but decent sit-down: Honey's Sit 'n Eat has brunch-y options and can usually seat quickly.
Jorge: Parking heads-up: limited on South St, better to advise client to take SEPTA to 8th St or hop a short Lyft.
Maya: Also — if they care about GF-certified bakeries, check out Gayle's or Blackbird Pizzeria (they do GF crust).
Katherine: I'll volunteer to handle logistics. Priya, do you want me to call High Street and ask about a 12:30 group pre-order?
Priya: Yes please, if you can confirm a 30-min turnaround. Also need an 8am coffee/pastry pickup for 3 at the office — any place that can do quick pre-orders?
Lena: La Colombe sometimes takes pre-orders for large batches via their catering line; ReAnimator maybe not. I can DM you the catering contact.
lunchbot: :spiral_calendar: Lunch poll: Vedge (sit-down) / High Street (fast-casual) / Reading Terminal (market) — vote with emoji within 2h.
Tom: +1 High Street (voted :one:).
Jorge: Reading Terminal from me (:two:).
Maya: Vedge (fine if client is into an experience) (:three:).
Priya: Thanks all — leaning High Street for midday, La Colombe for morning. Katherine, if you can try to call them, that'd be awesome. I'll post confirmed plan after booking.
Katherine: On it. Will post back with ETA/reservation.
